title_zh: 懒惰高维区间中扩散模型的泛化、过拟合与记忆

verified_metadata.title: Generalization, memorization, and overfitting for diffusion models trained in the lazy high-dimensional regime
verified_metadata.abstract: Modern score-based generative models have achieved remarkable empirical success in high-dimensional tasks such as image, audio, and video synthesis. These models reduce distribution learning to a sequence of regression problems that, if solved exactly on finite data, would ultimately reproduce the training samples. Their ability to generalize must therefore arise from the implicit or explicit regularization during training. In this work, we develop a generative counterpart to the theory of benign overfitting and algorithmic regularization for overparameterized neural networks in the supervised lazy-training regime. We study denoising score matching in a vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert space with an inner-product kernel. In the proportional high-dimensional regime $n\asymp d$, we derive exact risk trajectories under gradient flow training. These trajectories exhibit three phases governed by qualitatively distinct estimators: a spectral estimator that generalizes, a pure-noise score with localized peaks that interpolate the training objective, and an empirical Bayes estimator that memorizes the data. We then analyze how these estimators combine along the reverse-time SDE and characterize the distribution of the resulting samples. The analysis reveals familiar mechanisms from supervised learning, including kernel linearization and self-induced regularization from the nonlinear part of the kernel, but also reveals a distinct phenomenology specific to generative modeling.

sections.title: 作者信息
bullets: 作者：Hugo Latourelle-Vigeant、Sinho Chewi、Aram-Alexandre Pooladian、John Sous、Theodor Misiakiewicz。
Yale University：Department of Statistics and Data Science、Institute for Foundations of Data Science、Department of Applied Physics。

sections.title: 摘要
paragraphs: 在 $n\asymp d$ 的高维比例极限中，作者对向量值 RKHS 内的 denoising score matching 梯度流推导精确风险轨迹。训练依次经过谱估计器泛化、局域尖峰插值训练目标、经验 Bayes 估计器记忆样本三个阶段；反向 SDE 又表现出路径级线性化，使早停生成分布具有高斯归纳偏置。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: 扩散模型把分布学习化为一系列回归问题，而有限样本上的精确回归最终会复制训练集。问题是：泛化、训练目标过拟合与样本记忆是否是同一事件，还是由不同时间尺度控制？

sections.title: 为什么进入 Daily
paragraphs: 给出 score matching 从泛化到过拟合再到记忆的精确时间尺度分解，并证明训练损失插值不等于样本记忆。 本次遴选不是依据标题关键词或摘要热度：先从 2026-08-26 的官方 arXiv 分类清单锁定 v1 候选，再核对全文中的问题定义、方法、关键公式、实验或定理、限制条件和资源声明。该文按统一 40 分量表得到 37/40，达到 Daily 的 S 级门槛；分数只表示本网站本轮的相关性与证据完整度，不替代同行评议。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: 目标分布经线性高斯通道加噪；score estimator 位于带 inner-product kernel 的向量值 RKHS，并以梯度流训练。随机矩阵确定性等价给出 Phase I 风险，局域插值构造控制 Phase II，经验 Bayes 极限控制 Phase III；Theorems 4-5 再把 estimator 结果传到 reverse-time SDE。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
bullets: Figure 1 与 Theorems 1-3：$t=O(d)$ 时谱 shrinkage estimator 在 $t_\star\asymp d$ 达到最优测试风险；$t=d^{1+\Theta(1)}$ 时局域 bumps 令训练误差趋零、测试点却主要看到 pure-noise score；$t=d^{\omega(1)}$ 才收敛到经验 Bayes denoiser并记忆。
Theorem 4 证明早停区间内经验 reverse SDE 与线性化过程的路径律接近；Theorem 5 给出生成协方差的确定性等价。结论不是‘lazy diffusion 能生成任意分布’，而是它在该极限中只保留目标的一、二阶矩并趋向高斯。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: 理论限于 isotropic inner-product kernel、lazy training 和 $n\asymp d$；论文明确指出 feature learning、卷积/注意力/局域结构或低内禀维数可逃离该多项式屏障。100 页证明尚未覆盖现代大规模 U-Net/DiT 的特征学习动力学。
